blocks.x: In over three years at Collider, senior author Jake has now penned over 3000 articles covering a wide range of TV and film for the resources, lists, utilities, news, and interview teams. Alongside interviewing stars such as Selin Hizli, Rose Ayling-Ellis, Harlan Coben, and Chelsea Peretti, Jake was lucky enough to visit the set of Aardman and Netflix's Wallace and Gromit: A Vengeance Most Fowl in 2024, getting the chance to chat with four-time Academy Award winner Nick Park and Merlin Crossingham. Jake has also worked for other publications, including Agents of Fandom. You can also hear Jake every week as the resident film and TV journalist on Track Radio.

Since the dawn of the streaming wars, no show has had more of an impact on viewing culture than Stranger Things. One of the best sci-fi shows of all time, the Duffer Brothers' acclaimed blend of horror and sci-fi even managed to maintain its unbeatable status with the release of its final season late last year, despite being off-screen for several years. By earning 23.26 billion minutes viewed between December 29, 2025, and June 28, 2026, the series is the most-watched show of 2026 so far, despite not even airing this year.

The series also broke a record during this time, with 8.65 billion minutes accumulated in the week the series finale debuted. The success of Stranger Things stretches back to its 2016 launch, which became Netflix's third-most-watched original debut at the time. One of the many examples of the show's wide-reaching success is the subsequent stardom of its main cast, including Millie Bobby Brown and recent Spider-Man: Brand New Day star Sadie Sink. But Stranger Things simply wouldn't be the phenomenon it is today without its many high-profile influences.

One of these influences is the 1985 film The Goonies, with director Richard Donner's tale of young friendship and '80s adventure having a clear impact on Stranger Things. Boasting one of the finest young casts of all time, including Sean Astin, Thanos himself Josh Brolin, future Oscar winner Ke Huy Quan, Corey Feldman, and many more, the beloved adventure flick is still held dear to the hearts of millions over four decades later. This is why it should come as no surprise to learn that, at the time of writing, The Goonies is one of the ten most-watched movies on free streamer Tubi in the U.S.

What Fantasy World Do You Belong To?
Middle-earth · Grand Line · The Continent · Camp Half-Blood

Pick your magic, your crew, where you want to wake up and who you would rather be fighting, and we will tell you which world you actually belong in. Four are open to you: an ancient kingdom living through its last good age, an endless sea full of pirates, a continent that pays people to kill monsters, and a summer camp where the Greek gods are extremely real and mostly a nuisance.

What kind of power do you want?
Every one of these worlds runs on a completely different sort of magic.

ASomething ancient and half forgotten that came down through my family.
BSomething completely ridiculous that works in a fight and gets a laugh.
CNo magic at all, just training, potions and a very sharp sword.
DSomething I inherited from a parent I have barely met.

Nobody gets through any of these stories entirely on their own.

AA fellowship drawn from every corner of the world who barely trust each other.
BA crew I picked up one at a time, all of whom would die for me.
CTwo or three people I would never describe out loud as friends.
DTwo mates from school who are exactly as out of their depth as I am.

Where do you want to wake up tomorrow?
The best fantasy is usually just somewhere you would genuinely like to live.

AA high city of white stone with the sea somewhere far below.
BA ship under sail, with an island ahead that nobody has mapped.
CA rented room over a tavern, in a town I am leaving in the morning.
DA cabin at a summer camp with everybody else already awake outside.

Even in fantasy somebody has to pay for the horse.

AI am not, because somebody far older than me decided this was my duty.
BTreasure, and I am not always careful about whose it used to be.
CI take contracts, since people will pay well for what they will not touch.
DI am fifteen and this is all technically a school trip.

All four of these worlds keep something unpleasant out there in the dark.

ASend word to somebody who has seen this before, then hold the line.

CAsk what it has been eating and what the village is willing to pay.
DWork out which myth it escaped from, then improvise very badly.
